parameters.command:
=LOCK_DIR="/media/dub/.pipeline.lock"
STALE_SECS=900
while true; do
  if mkdir "$LOCK_DIR" 2>/dev/null; then
    date +%s > "$LOCK_DIR/owner"
    echo "LOCK_ACQUIRED at $(date '+%H:%M:%S')"
    break
  fi
  if [ -f "$LOCK_DIR/owner" ]; then
    LOCK_TS=$(cat "$LOCK_DIR/owner" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
    AGE=$(( $(date +%s) - LOCK_TS ))
    if [ "$AGE" -gt "$STALE_SECS" ]; then
      echo "Stale lock (age=${AGE}s) - taking over"
      rm -rf "$LOCK_DIR"
      continue
    fi
  fi
  echo "Queue: waiting for previous job to finish..."
  sleep 4
done

# ── Install/update yt-dlp via pip (NOT the standalone GitHub-release binary).
#    The standalone binary bundles its own Python + deps, so a system-wide
#    "pip install curl_cffi" is invisible to it and --impersonate chrome
#    always fails with "Impersonate target chrome is not available" even
#    after installing curl_cffi. Installing yt-dlp itself via pip makes it
#    run on the SAME system Python where curl_cffi is installed, so
#    impersonation (needed by xiaohongshu/douyin/iqiyi) actually works. ──
YT="yt-dlp"
STAMP="/media/dub/.yt-dlp-pip-stamp"
if ! command -v yt-dlp >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ ! -f "$STAMP" ] || [ -n "$(find "$STAMP" -mmin +1440 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
  echo "Installing/updating yt-dlp via pip..."
  timeout 90 pip3 install --quiet --break-system-packages --only-binary=:all: -U yt-dlp 2>&1 | tail -5
  # yt-dlp itself is pure-python and always has a wheel; if --only-binary
  # somehow rejects it, fall back once without the flag (still time-capped).
  command -v yt-dlp >/dev/null 2>&1 || timeout 90 pip3 install --quiet --break-system-packages -U yt-dlp 2>&1 | tail -5
  touch "$STAMP" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
echo "yt-dlp version: $($YT --version 2>/dev/null || echo 'MISSING')"

# ── Ensure curl_cffi is installed so --impersonate chrome actually works ──
# NOTE: "yt-dlp --list-impersonate-targets" always lists "chrome" as a KNOWN
# target name regardless of whether curl_cffi is actually installed/working -
# it enumerates supported backends, not verified-available ones. Checking its
# output was a false-positive check that skipped installing curl_cffi
# entirely. Check real importability instead.
# --only-binary + a hard timeout: curl_cffi is a C-extension package and if
# no prebuilt wheel matches this VPS's arch/Python, pip would otherwise try
# to compile it from source - on this box's very limited RAM that can hang
# for a long time (or swap-thrash) instead of failing fast. Better to skip
# impersonation than to stall every single download for 15+ minutes.
if ! python3 -c "import curl_cffi" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "Installing curl_cffi for browser impersonation support..."
  timeout 60 pip3 install --quiet --break-system-packages --only-binary=:all: -U 'curl_cffi>=0.10' 2>&1 | tail -5
  if ! python3 -c "import curl_cffi" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "WARN: curl_cffi still not importable (no prebuilt wheel for this VPS, or install timed out) - continuing without impersonation"
  fi
fi

        URL=$(echo "$FOLLOWED" | sed -E 's#https?://([a-z0-9-]+\.)*rednote\.com#https://www.xiaohongshu.com#I')

      else
        echo "WARN: could not resolve xhslink short link (got: $FOLLOWED)"
      fi
    fi
    XHS_HDRS=(--add-header "Referer:https://www.xiaohongshu.com/" --add-header "Accept-Language:zh-CN,zh;q=0.9,en;q=0.8")
    if [ -f "$XHS_COOKIES" ]; then
      echo "Using Xiaohongshu cookies (with browser-like headers)..."
      $YT --impersonate chrome --cookies "$XHS_COOKIES" "${XHS_HDRS[@]}" \
        -f "best" $COMMON_OUT "$URL" 2>&1
    else
      $YT --impersonate chrome "${XHS_HDRS[@]}" \
        -f "best" $COMMON_OUT "$URL" 2>&1
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$WD/source.mp4" ] && [ -f "$XHS_COOKIES" ]; then

        -f "best" $COMMON_OUT "$URL" 2>&1
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$WD/source.mp4" ]; then
      echo "--- XHS fallback: generic extractor ---"
      $YT --user-agent "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" "${XHS_HDRS[@]}" \
        -f "best" $COMMON_OUT "$URL" 2>&1
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$WD/source.mp4" ]; then
      echo "--- XHS fallback: parse page HTML for the video URL ---"
      XHS_CK=""
      [ -f "$XHS_COOKIES" ] && XHS_CK="-b $XHS_COOKIES"
      curl -sL --max-time 25 -A "$XHS_UA" $XHS_CK -H "Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9" -H "Referer: https://www.xiaohongshu.com/" "$URL" -o "$WD/xhs_page.html"
      cat > "$WD/xhs_extract.py" << 'XHSPY'
import re, sys
h = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").read()
found = []
for p in (r'"masterUrl":"(http[^"]+)"', r'<meta[^>]+name="og:video"[^>]+content="([^"]+)"', r'<meta[^>]+property="og:video"[^>]+content="([^"]+)"', r'"url":"(http[^"]+\.mp4[^"]*)"'):
    for m in re.findall(p, h):
        found.append(m.replace("\\u002F", "/").replace("&", "&"))
print(found[0] if found else "")
XHSPY
      XHS_VID=$(python3 "$WD/xhs_extract.py" "$WD/xhs_page.html")
      if [ -n "$XHS_VID" ]; then
        echo "Found video URL in page HTML, downloading..."
        curl -sL --max-time 300 -A "$XHS_UA" -H "Referer: https://www.xiaohongshu.com/" "$XHS_VID" -o "$WD/source.mp4"
        [ -s "$WD/source.mp4" ] || rm -f "$WD/source.mp4"
      else
        echo "No video URL found in page HTML (image post, or login wall)"
      fi
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$WD/source.mp4" ]; then
      if [ -f "$XHS_COOKIES" ]; then
        echo "ERROR: Xiaohongshu still redirected to login even with cookies attached. The cookies are likely stale/expired, or this specific post requires a fresh, actively-logged-in session (re-export xhs_cookies.txt right before testing), or Xiaohongshu has tightened access for shared links generally. The reliable fallback: send the video file directly instead of the link."
      else
        echo "ERROR: This Xiaohongshu post requires a logged-in session (redirected to login page). Export your Xiaohongshu cookies (browser extension, e.g. \"Get cookies.txt LOCALLY\") and upload as xhs_cookies.txt to /media/dub/, or send the video file directly instead of the link."
      fi
    fi
    ;;
  douyin)
    echo "=== Douyin Download ==="
    DY_UA="Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_0 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.0 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1"
    if echo "$URL" | grep -qiE "v\.douyin\.com"; then
      FOLLOWED=$(curl -sL -o /dev/null -w '%{url_effective}' --max-time 20 -A "$DY_UA" "$URL")
      if echo "$FOLLOWED" | grep -qiE "douyin\.com|iesdouyin\.com"; then
        URL="$FOLLOWED"
        echo "Resolved short link to: $URL"
      else
        echo "WARN: could not resolve v.douyin.com short link (got: $FOLLOWED)"
      fi
    fi
    if [ -f "$DOUYIN_COOKIES" ]; then
      echo "Using Douyin cookies..."
      $YT --impersonate chrome --cookies "$DOUYIN_COOKIES" \
        -f "best" $COMMON_OUT "$URL" 2>&1
    else
      $YT --impersonate chrome \
        -f "best" $COMMON_OUT "$URL" 2>&1
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$WD/source.mp4" ]; then
      echo "--- Douyin fallback: mobile UA ---"
      $YT --user-agent "Mozilla/5.0 (iPhone; CPU iPhone OS 17_0 like Mac OS X) AppleWebKit/605.1.15 (KHTML, like Gecko) Version/17.0 Mobile/15E148 Safari/604.1" \
        -f "best" $COMMON_OUT "$URL" 2>&1
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$WD/source.mp4" ]; then
      echo "--- Douyin fallback: generic Chrome UA ---"
      $YT --user-agent "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" \
        -f "best" $COMMON_OUT "$URL" 2>&1
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$WD/source.mp4" ]; then
      echo "--- Douyin fallback: parse page HTML for the video URL ---"
      DY_CK=""
      [ -f "$DOUYIN_COOKIES" ] && DY_CK="-b $DOUYIN_COOKIES"
      curl -sL --max-time 25 -A "$DY_UA" $DY_CK -H "Referer: https://www.douyin.com/" "$URL" -o "$WD/douyin_page.html"
      cat > "$WD/douyin_extract.py" << 'DYPY'
import re, sys
h = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore").read()
found = []
def unesc(u):
    u = u.replace("\\/", "/").replace("&", "&")
    try:
        u = re.sub(r"\\u([0-9a-fA-F]{4})", lambda m: chr(int(m.group(1), 16)), u)
    except Exception:
        pass
    return u

for p in (r'"play_addr"\s*:\s*\{[^}]*?"url_list"\s*:\s*\[\s*"([^"]+)"', r'"playAddr"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', r'<meta[^>]+property="og:video"[^>]+content="([^"]+)"', r'<meta[^>]+name="og:video"[^>]+content="([^"]+)"'):
    for m in re.findall(p, h):
        found.append(unesc(m))
print(found[0] if found else "")
DYPY
      DY_VID=$(python3 "$WD/douyin_extract.py" "$WD/douyin_page.html")
      if [ -n "$DY_VID" ]; then
        echo "Found video URL in page HTML, downloading..."
        curl -sL --max-time 300 -A "$DY_UA" -H "Referer: https://www.douyin.com/" "$DY_VID" -o "$WD/source.mp4"
        [ -s "$WD/source.mp4" ] || rm -f "$WD/source.mp4"
      else
        echo "No video URL found in page HTML (login wall, or removed post)"
      fi
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$WD/source.mp4" ] && [ ! -f "$DOUYIN_COOKIES" ]; then
      echo "ERROR: Douyin requires logged-in cookies. Ask admin to upload douyin_cookies.txt to /media/dub/"
    fi
    ;;
  iqiyi)
    echo "=== iQiyi Download ==="
    RESOLVED_URL="$URL"
    if echo "$URL" | grep -qiE "qy\.net"; then
      echo "Resolving iQiyi short link..."
      FOLLOWED=$(curl -sIL -o /dev/null -w '%{url_effective}' --max-time 15 -A "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" "$URL")
      if [ -n "$FOLLOWED" ] && echo "$FOLLOWED" | grep -qiE "iqiyi\.com|iq\.com"; then
        RESOLVED_URL="$FOLLOWED"
        echo "Resolved to: $RESOLVED_URL"
      else
        echo "WARN: could not resolve short link (got: $FOLLOWED) - trying original URL as-is"
      fi
    fi
    # playShare.html is a social-share landing page, not a real video page -
    # yt-dlp's iqiyi extractor can't parse it (no tvid/vid markers in that
    # template). Fetch it and pull the canonical v_xxxx.html / iq.com/play
    # link the page itself points to, and use THAT for extraction instead.
    if echo "$RESOLVED_URL" | grep -qiE "playShare\.html"; then
      echo "Share landing page detected, looking for canonical video URL..."
      SHARE_HTML=$(curl -sL --max-time 15 -A "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" "$RESOLVED_URL")
      CANON=$(echo "$SHARE_HTML" | grep -ozE '(https?:)?//[a-zA-Z0-9.-]*i[qQ](iyi\.com/v_[a-zA-Z0-9]+\.html|\.com/play/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+)' | tr -d '\0' | head -1)
      if [ -n "$CANON" ]; then
        case "$CANON" in //*) CANON="https:$CANON" ;; esac
        echo "Found canonical URL: $CANON"
        RESOLVED_URL="$CANON"
      else
        echo "WARN: could not find a canonical video URL on the share page - extraction may fail"
      fi
    fi
    if [ -f "$IQIYI_COOKIES" ]; then
      echo "Using iQiyi cookies..."
      $YT --impersonate chrome --cookies "$IQIYI_COOKIES" \
        -f "best" $COMMON_OUT "$RESOLVED_URL" 2>&1
    else
      $YT --impersonate chrome \
        -f "best" $COMMON_OUT "$RESOLVED_URL" 2>&1
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$WD/source.mp4" ]; then
      echo "--- iQiyi fallback: generic Chrome UA ---"
      $YT --user-agent "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" \
        -f "best" $COMMON_OUT "$RESOLVED_URL" 2>&1
    fi
    if [ ! -f "$WD/source.mp4" ]; then
      echo "ERROR: iQiyi extraction failed. VIP/paid movies are DRM-protected and yt-dlp cannot download them - only free, non-VIP videos work."
    fi
    ;;
  local)
    echo "=== Local File ==="
    # LOCAL_KEY is chatId_messageId (unique per uploaded message) so rapid
    # back-to-back uploads from the same user each get their own file
    # instead of colliding on a single shared ${chatId}.mp4 path.
    SRC="/media/dub/uploads/${LOCAL_KEY}.mp4"
    if [ ! -f "$SRC" ]; then
      echo "LOCAL_KEY file not found, falling back to legacy \${chatId}.mp4 path..."
      SRC="/media/dub/uploads/${CHAT_ID}.mp4"
    fi
    if [ -f "$SRC" ]; then
      cp "$SRC" "$WD/source.mp4"
      rm -f "$SRC"
    else
      echo "ERROR: uploaded file not found at $SRC"
    fi
    ;;
  *)
    echo "ERROR: Unsupported platform: $PLATFORM"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

  cp "$SRT_FILE" "$WD/source.srt"

Render v8 - Dual mode.
RECAP mode  (default): forward jump-cut, output length ~= narration length (compressed highlight reel).
FULL mode: native full-length video (no cuts), narration placed at correct src_start timestamps

    cmd = ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", entries, "-of", "csv=p=0"]
    if stream:
        cmd += ["-select_streams", stream]
    cmd += [path]
    return subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()

        FPS = int(round(f)) if f > 0 else 30
    except Exception:

    man = json.load(f)
if not man:

_BASE_VF = (

const langName = $('Validate URL').first().json.lang_name;
const segments = $('Parse Transcript').first().json.segments || [];
const gapFrames = $json.gapFrames || [];

// render_mode: 'recap' (default) condenses the story into a short-form cut.
// 'full' (Full Dub Mode) keeps the ENTIRE original video untouched and dubs
// every dialogue line at its original timestamp - see Render node.
const renderMode = ($('Validate URL').first().json.render_mode || 'recap');
const isFull = renderMode === 'full';

// Map gap id -> 1-based index in the imageParts array built below. This is
// the source of truth for which "image N" label goes with which segment.
// Previously the image numbers were pre-computed in Parse Transcript BEFORE
// frame extraction even ran, assuming every gap would succeed. Whenever a
// single gap's frame extraction failed and was dropped from gapFrames, every
// later gap's image silently shifted by one position - so Gemini would look
// at "image 3" and actually receive the frame meant for a different segment
// entirely (e.g. a street-walking scene's narration attached to a
// sleeping-in-bed frame). Building the mapping here, from the FINAL gapFrames
// list, guarantees the label always matches the actual attached image.
const gapIdToImageIndex = new Map();
gapFrames.forEach((g, i) => gapIdToImageIndex.set(g.id, i + 1));

// Full Dub Mode never narrates VISUAL SCENE (no-dialogue) gaps - those stay
// silent in the final dub, exactly as they were in the original video - so
// there is nothing for Gemini to look at and attaching the frames would only
// waste payload/cost. Only Recap Mode needs the images to write a scene
// description.
const imageParts = isFull ? [] : gapFrames.map(g => ({
  inlineData: { mimeType: g.mime || 'image/jpeg', data: g.data }
}));

function fmtTs(sec) {
  const totalMs = Math.round(sec * 1000);
  const h = Math.floor(totalMs / 3600000);
  const m = Math.floor((totalMs % 3600000) / 60000);
  const s = Math.floor((totalMs % 60000) / 1000);
  const ms = totalMs % 1000;
  const pad = (n, l) => String(n).padStart(l, '0');
  return `${pad(h,2)}:${pad(m,2)}:${pad(s,2)},${pad(ms,3)}`;
}

// Rebuild the numbered transcript text HERE (instead of trusting Parse
// Transcript's pre-computed version) so gap image numbers are guaranteed
// correct against the FINAL imageParts array built above.
const numberedLines = [];
for (const s of segments) {
  const startTs = s.start || fmtTs(s.start_sec);
  const endTs = s.end || fmtTs(s.end_sec);
  if (s.isGap) {
    let label;
    if (isFull) {
      // Full Dub Mode: this window has no original dialogue, so it stays
      // silent in the final dub exactly as it was in the source video - no
      // narration is added here at all.
      label = `[VISUAL SCENE - no dialogue in the original video - output an empty string "" for this segment's burmese, do NOT write any narration or description]`;
    } else {
      const imgIdx = gapIdToImageIndex.get(s.id);
      label = imgIdx
        ? `[VISUAL SCENE - no dialogue, see attached image ${imgIdx}]`
        : `[VISUAL SCENE - no dialogue, no image available for this moment - write a brief neutral scene-transition line, do not guess at specific visual details]`;
    }
    numberedLines.push(`${s.id}|${startTs}|${endTs}|${s.duration_sec.toFixed(2)}s|${label}`);
  } else {
    numberedLines.push(`${s.id}|${startTs}|${endTs}|${s.duration_sec.toFixed(2)}s|${s.text}`);
    if (s.phrases && s.phrases.length > 1) {
      for (let pi = 0; pi < s.phrases.length; pi++) {
        const p = s.phrases[pi];
        const pdur = (p.end - p.start).toFixed(2);
        numberedLines.push(`${s.id}.P${pi+1}|${fmtTs(p.start)}|${fmtTs(p.end)}|${pdur}s|${p.text}`);
      }
    }
  }

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Generate Voiceover MV v1 - multi-voice edge-tts.
# Text may contain inline voice markers: <<N>> narrator, <<M>> man, <<F>> woman,
# <<OM>> old man, <<OF>> old woman, <<KID>> child. Untagged text = narrator voice.
# Same outputs as gen_vo v13: vo_full.mp3 + vo_manifest.json.
import sys, os, re, json, subprocess, time, shutil

WD = sys.argv[1]
VOICE = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 'my-MM-ThihaNeural'
VIDEO_DUR = float(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv) > 3 and sys.argv[3] else 0.0
TONE = sys.argv[5] if len(sys.argv) > 5 else 'natural'

EDGE_VOICES = {
    'my-MM-ThihaNeural', 'my-MM-NilarNeural',
    'it-IT-GiuseppeMultilingualNeural', 'fr-FR-VivienneMultilingualNeural',
    'en-US-AvaMultilingualNeural', 'en-US-EmmaMultilingualNeural',
    'fr-FR-RemyMultilingualNeural',
}
if VOICE not in EDGE_VOICES:
    VOICE = 'my-MM-ThihaNeural'
if TONE not in ('natural', 'deep', 'soft', 'bright'):
    TONE = 'natural'

GAP = 0.180
PART_GAP = 0.120
HEADROOM = 0.94
ATEMPO_CAP = 1.80

EDGE_TONE_PARAMS = {
    'natural': ('+0%', '+0Hz'),
    'deep': ('-5%', '-15Hz'),
    'soft': ('-5%', '-8Hz'),
    'bright': ('+5%', '+15Hz'),
}
NARR_RATE, NARR_PITCH = EDGE_TONE_PARAMS[TONE]

# marker -> (voice, rate, pitch)
CHAR_VOICES = {
    'M': ('my-MM-ThihaNeural', '+0%', '+0Hz'),
    'F': ('my-MM-NilarNeural', '+0%', '+0Hz'),
    'OM': ('my-MM-ThihaNeural', '-12%', '-25Hz'),
    'OF': ('my-MM-NilarNeural', '-12%', '-12Hz'),
    'KID': ('my-MM-NilarNeural', '+8%', '+40Hz'),
}
MARK_RE = re.compile(r'<<(N|M|F|OM|OF|KID)>>')
AF_NORM = 'loudnorm=I=-6:TP=-0.3:LRA=5,volume=6dB,alimiter=limit=0.98'


def ffprobe_dur(p):
    r = subprocess.run(['ffprobe', '-v', 'error', '-show_entries', 'format=duration',
                        '-of', 'csv=p=0', p], capture_output=True, text=True)
    try:
        return float(r.stdout.strip())
    except Exception:
        return 0.0


def strip_tags(t):
    while True:
        a = t.find('[')
        if a < 0:
            break
        b = t.find(']', a)
        if b < 0:
            break
        t = t[:a] + t[b + 1:]
    return re.sub(' {2,}', ' ', t.replace(chr(10), ' ')).strip()


def split_parts(text):
    '''Return [(tag, text)] in order; untagged lead text is narrator.'''
    pieces = MARK_RE.split(text)
    parts = []
    lead = strip_tags(pieces[0])
    if lead:
        parts.append(('N', lead))
    i = 1
    while i < len(pieces) - 1:
        tag = pieces[i]
        txt = strip_tags(pieces[i + 1])
        if txt:
            parts.append((tag, txt))
        i += 2
    return parts


def edge_tts_call(text, out_mp3, voice, rate, pitch, retries=5):
    last = None
    for a in range(retries):
        try:
            r = subprocess.run(['edge-tts', '--voice', voice, '--rate=' + rate, '--pitch=' + pitch,
                                '--text', text, '--write-media', out_mp3],
                               capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120)
            if os.path.exists(out_mp3) and os.path.getsize(out_mp3) > 200:
                return True
            last = (r.stderr or r.stdout or '')[:240]
        except Exception as e:
            last = str(e)[:240]
        time.sleep(min(2.0 * (2 ** a), 12.0))
    print('    edge-tts FAIL after retries: %s' % last)
    return False


def synth_part(tag, text, out_mp3):
    if tag in CHAR_VOICES:
        v, r, p = CHAR_VOICES[tag]
        if edge_tts_call(text, out_mp3, v, r, p, retries=3):
            return True
        print('    character voice %s failed, falling back to narrator' % tag)
        if os.path.exists(out_mp3):
            os.remove(out_mp3)
    return edge_tts_call(text, out_mp3, VOICE, NARR_RATE, NARR_PITCH)


def make_silence(out_mp3, dur):
    subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-y', '-f', 'lavfi', '-i', 'anullsrc=r=44100:cl=stereo',
                    '-t', '%.3f' % dur, '-c:a', 'libmp3lame', '-q:a', '4', out_mp3],
                   capture_output=True, text=True)


with open(WD + '/segments.json', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    segs = json.load(f)
segs = [s for s in segs if (s.get('burmese') or '').strip()]
tag_counts = {}
for s in segs:
    for m in MARK_RE.findall(s.get('burmese', '')):
        tag_counts[m] = tag_counts.get(m, 0) + 1
print('INPUT_SEGMENTS_WITH_TEXT=%d VIDEO_DUR=%.2fs VOICE=%s TONE=%s' % (len(segs), VIDEO_DUR, VOICE, TONE))
print('VOICE_MARKERS=%s' % json.dumps(tag_counts))
if not segs:
    print('ERROR: no burmese segments')
    sys.exit(1)

tmp = WD + '/tts_seg'
os.makedirs(tmp, exist_ok=True)
sil_part = tmp + '/part_gap.mp3'
make_silence(sil_part, PART_GAP)

manifest = []
seg_audio = []
tts_ok = tts_fail = enc_fail = 0
parts_by_voice = {}

for idx, s in enumerate(segs):
    parts = split_parts(s.get('burmese', ''))
    src_start = float(s.get('start_sec') or 0.0)
    src_end = float(s.get('end_sec') or 0.0)
    if not parts:
        continue
    out = tmp + '/c%04d.mp3' % idx
    norm_files = []
    for pi, (tag, ptxt) in enumerate(parts):
        raw = tmp + '/r%04d_%d.mp3' % (idx, pi)
        if not synth_part(tag, ptxt, raw):
            continue
        time.sleep(0.35)
        if ffprobe_dur(raw) <= 0:
            if os.path.exists(raw):
                os.remove(raw)
            continue
        nf = tmp + '/n%04d_%d.mp3' % (idx, pi)
        subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-y', '-i', raw, '-af', AF_NORM, '-ar', '44100', '-ac', '2',
                        '-c:a', 'libmp3lame', '-q:a', '2', nf], capture_output=True, text=True)
        if os.path.exists(raw):
            os.remove(raw)
        if os.path.exists(nf) and os.path.getsize(nf) > 200:
            norm_files.append(nf)
            parts_by_voice[tag] = parts_by_voice.get(tag, 0) + 1
    if not norm_files:
        tts_fail += 1
        make_silence(out, 0.5 + GAP)
        manifest.append({'seg_id': s.get('id'), 'src_start': src_start, 'src_end': src_end,
                         'dur': ffprobe_dur(out), 'isGap': bool(s.get('isGap'))})
        seg_audio.append(out)
        continue
    tts_ok += 1
    joined = tmp + '/j%04d.mp3' % idx
    if len(norm_files) == 1:
        joined = norm_files[0]
    else:
        lst = tmp + '/l%04d.txt' % idx
        with open(lst, 'w') as lf:
            for k, nf in enumerate(norm_files):
                if k > 0:
                    lf.write('file ' + chr(39) + sil_part + chr(39) + chr(10))
                lf.write('file ' + chr(39) + nf + chr(39) + chr(10))
        subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-y', '-f', 'concat', '-safe', '0', '-i', lst, '-ar', '44100',
                        '-ac', '2', '-c:a', 'libmp3lame', '-q:a', '2', joined],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    raw_dur = ffprobe_dur(joined)
    if raw_dur <= 0:
        enc_fail += 1
        continue
    target = raw_dur + GAP
    r = subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-y', '-i', joined, '-af', 'apad', '-t', '%.3f' % target,
                        '-ar', '44100', '-ac', '2', '-c:a', 'libmp3lame', '-q:a', '2', out],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    if not os.path.exists(out) or os.path.getsize(out) < 200:
        enc_fail += 1
        print('  seg %d ENCODE-FAIL: %s' % (idx, (r.stderr or '')[-200:]))
        continue
    d = ffprobe_dur(out)
    manifest.append({'seg_id': s.get('id'), 'src_start': src_start, 'src_end': src_end,
                     'dur': d, 'isGap': bool(s.get('isGap'))})
    seg_audio.append(out)

print('TTS_OK=%d TTS_FAIL=%d ENCODE_FAIL=%d USABLE=%d' % (tts_ok, tts_fail, enc_fail, len(seg_audio)))
print('PARTS_BY_VOICE=%s' % json.dumps(parts_by_voice))
if not seg_audio:
    print('ERROR: no audio produced')
    sys.exit(1)

fail_ratio = tts_fail / max(1, len(segs))
if fail_ratio > 0.15:
    print('WARNING: HIGH_FAILURE_RATE=%.0f%% - output narration will be significantly shorter than source video due to TTS failures' % (fail_ratio * 100))

concat = tmp + '/concat.txt'
with open(concat, 'w') as f:
    for p in seg_audio:
        f.write('file ' + chr(39) + p + chr(39) + chr(10))
subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-y', '-f', 'concat', '-safe', '0', '-i', concat,
                '-ar', '44100', '-ac', '2', '-c:a', 'libmp3lame', '-q:a', '2',
                WD + '/vo_full.mp3'], capture_output=True, text=True)
vo_total = ffprobe_dur(WD + '/vo_full.mp3')
print('VO_RAW_TOTAL=%.2fs' % vo_total)

fit = 1.0
if VIDEO_DUR > 1 and vo_total > VIDEO_DUR * HEADROOM:
    fit = vo_total / (VIDEO_DUR * HEADROOM)
    fit = min(max(fit, 1.0), ATEMPO_CAP)
    subprocess.run(['ffmpeg', '-y', '-i', WD + '/vo_full.mp3', '-af', 'atempo=%.5f' % fit,
                    '-ar', '44100', '-ac', '2', '-c:a', 'libmp3lame', '-q:a', '2',
                    WD + '/vo_fit.mp3'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if os.path.exists(WD + '/vo_fit.mp3') and os.path.getsize(WD + '/vo_fit.mp3') > 200:
        os.replace(WD + '/vo_fit.mp3', WD + '/vo_full.mp3')
        for m in manifest:
            m['dur'] = m['dur'] / fit
        vo_total = ffprobe_dur(WD + '/vo_full.mp3')
    else:
        fit = 1.0
print('GLOBAL_FIT_ATEMPO=%.4f VO_FINAL=%.2fs (target<= %.2fs)' % (fit, vo_total, VIDEO_DUR * HEADROOM))

with open(WD + '/vo_manifest.json', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(manifest, f, ensure_ascii=False)

shutil.rmtree(tmp, ignore_errors=True)
man_total = sum(m['dur'] for m in manifest)
print('VO_SEGMENTS=%d VO_TOTAL=%.2fs MANIFEST_SUM=%.2fs' % (len(manifest), vo_total, man_total))
print('VO_BUILD_DONE')
GENEOF_MARKER
python3 "$WD/gen_vo_mv.py" "$WD" "$VOICE" "$DURATION" "" "$TONE" 2>&1
RC=$?
if [ ! -s "$WD/vo_full.mp3" ]; then echo "ERROR: vo_full.mp3 not produced (rc=$RC)"; exit 1; fi
if [ ! -s "$WD/vo_manifest.json" ]; then echo "ERROR: vo_manifest.json not produced (rc=$RC)"; exit 1; fi
FINAL_VO_DUR=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of csv=p=0 "$WD/vo_full.mp3" 2>/dev/null)
echo "VO_FINAL_DURATION=${FINAL_VO_DUR}s"
echo "DONE"
